description: Na₃VS₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅42₁c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VS₄ tetrahedra, edges with six NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent VS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.19 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.07 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent VS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-37°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-2.90 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.26 Å. V is bonded to four S atoms to form VS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaS₆ octahedra and edges with two NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-78°. There are a spread of V-S bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.16 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form SNa₅V octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SNa₄V trigonal bipyramid, edges with three equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SNa₄V trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. In the second S site, S is bonded to four Na and one V atom to form distorted SNa₄V trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₅V octahedra, corners with three equivalent SNa₄V trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom.
